name: What is Opus Builders' process for managing a whole-home renovation from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What is Opus Builders' process for managing a whole-home renovation from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an in-depth consultation to understand your vision, lifestyle, and objectives. This leads to the conceptual design phase, followed by detailed architectural drawings and material selections. Once designs are finalized and permits secured, our construction team meticulously executes the plan, maintaining open communication and rigorous quality control. We manage all aspects, from demolition and structural work to interior finishes and landscaping, ensuring a seamless and integrated project delivery. Our dedicated project managers oversee schedules, budgets, and craftsmanship to bring your luxury home to life.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves consultation, design, permitting, and meticulous construction execution. We manage all phases from concept to completion, ensuring quality and communication.
